_about: Contractor: Fallen's people's lines (docs/survival_people.md section 5, call 54/76). A topic lists lines; a line's tags must all be the speaker's (TalkMenu.tags_of: status, mood band, scared/cocky, traits, want kind, disposition, grudge) and the most specific match wins, ties picked at random. Untagged lines are the fallback. {name} {first} {want} {zone} {background} {item} fill in. Short and plain: the TTS voices them later. Each line has a `voice` (its clip's name, <topic>_<NN>, under assets/voices/survival/<voice set>/) and a `speaker` (kind, sex, age: the voices tools/voices/render_survival.py renders it in); `voice_text` is what's said when it differs from the subtitle (VoiceLines, docs/survival_audio.md).

greet.text: I'm {first}. That's all you need for now.
Stay back. Please. I don't want any trouble.
Don't come closer. I mean it. I'm just {first}.
Look what crawled in. You lost, or just stupid?
{first}. And this is my patch, so talk fast.
Oh thank god, a living face. I'm {first}.
{first}. Not that names matter much now.
It's me, {first}. Who else would it be.

warn.text: Hands where I can see them!
Keep walking. I've got nothing for you.

want.text: You want me along? Then I want {want}.
Cash still talks to me. {want}, and I come with you.
{want}. Do that for me and we'll talk.
I just want {want}. Somewhere I can sleep.
I'll come. I'd rather not be alone anymore.

place.text: {zone}? Quiet in the day. Don't trust the nights.
I came through {zone} on foot. The dead sit in the houses.
The church still had food last week. Maybe.
Every place is the same now. Empty or full of them.

trade.text: I'll trade when you've got something worth it.
Fair's fair. What are you carrying?

trade_no.text: I don't do the trading. Ask around.

trade_unfair.text: Put more on the table or walk.

trade_done.text: Pleasure. Come back when you've more.
Good trade. Stay safe out there.

rumour_none.text: I haven't heard anything about that.

recruit_yes.text: Deal. Don't make me regret it.
Thank you. Thank you. I'll pull my weight.

recruit_no.text: Not yet. You know what I want.
Come back with {want}. Then we'll talk.
You haven't done it yet. I'd know.
Where would I even sleep? Find a place first.
Not with you. Not after that.

threaten_calm.text: Put that down. Nobody needs to die today.

how_are_you.text: Good, actually. Feels like we've got a chance.
Not great. I keep thinking about before.
I can't do this much longer.

think.text: We're doing alright. Keep it quiet and keep moving.
We should push harder. They're slow.

hungry.text: I'm out of food. Anyone got a tin?
I need to eat something soon.

thirsty.text: I need water. I'm all out.

ate.text: Eating something, give me a second.

plan_dusk.text: We should find somewhere before dark.
Getting dark. Let's get walls around us.

plan_horde.text: There's a horde out there. We need to go quiet.
That's a lot of them. Let's not be here.

plan_idle.text: I know a clinic two towns over. Might be worth it.
That smoke earlier. Could be a camp.
We need more water before tomorrow.

refuse_order.text: No. Not in there. That's a horde.
You go if you want. I'm not walking into that.
I can't. I'm sorry, I can't.

refuse_again.text: Ask me a hundred times. Still no.

obey_grudging.text: If you say so. I'm with you.

grief.text: We should bury them. We owe them that.

bury_thanks.text: Thank you. They'd have wanted that.

put_down.text: That wasn't them anymore. It wasn't.

newcomer.text: Who are you? Where's the one who led us?

break_crying.text: I can't. I just need a minute. I can't.

break_rage.text: I'm sick of this! Sick of all of it!

break_binge.text: Leave me alone. I'm having this.

break_hiding.text: I'm not going out there. Not today.

break_desertion.text: I'm done. Don't come after me.

break_refusal.text: Don't ask me anything. I won't.

favour_done.text: You did it? Then I keep my word.

favour_marked.text: I marked it on your map. Don't take forever.

radio.text: A woman's voice, flat: "Seven. Four. Four. Nine. Arche. Seven. Four..." Then a tone, and nothing.
radio.voice_text: Seven. Four. Four. Nine. Arche. Seven. Four.

radio.text: A child's music box, then numbers in a man's voice: "Two. Zero. One. One. Arche holds."
radio.voice_text: Two. Zero. One. One. Arche holds.

radio.text: Three long tones. "Station Arche. Group one. Six, one, eight. Repeat: six, one, eight."
radio.voice_text: Station Arche. Group one. Six, one, eight. Repeat: six, one, eight.

raider_warn.text: This road's ours. Pay or turn around.
Drop the bag and walk away.

enclave_halt.text: Halt. Hands where we can see them.
Toll's due. No toll, no road.

dreams._about: Dreams (Dreams, call 119): a line on waking from sleep by the day's colour (the strongest mark: a loss, a horde, a bite, a kill, the dark line, hunger, a kindness) or a nightmare after a death. Written, not spoken: no voice keys.
calm: You dreamt of nothing. It was good.
You dreamt of rain on a tin roof, and nobody needed you.
You dreamt you were somewhere warm, and you stayed.
horde: You dreamt of a crowd walking past the window, all night, and none of them looked in.
You dreamt the field was full of them, standing still, waiting for you to move.
You dreamt of feet on gravel, thousands, and woke counting.
loss: You dreamt they were still here, laughing at something you said.
You dreamt you were digging, and the grave kept filling with water.
You dreamt of an empty chair and a plate set at it.
kindness: You dreamt of a warm kitchen and somebody calling you in.
You dreamt someone put a blanket over you and didn't say a word.
You dreamt of a fire, and of voices around it you trusted.
hunger: You dreamt of bread, and woke chewing.
You dreamt of a supermarket, full, lit, and nobody else there.
You dreamt of your mother's cooking. Your stomach woke you.
bite: You dreamt your arm was someone else's.
You dreamt you were hungry for something you couldn't name.
You dreamt of teeth, and checked the dressing twice before you got up.
killed: You dreamt of a face. You didn't know it then either.
You dreamt the shot never stopped echoing.
You dreamt the man got up and asked you why.
dark: You dreamt of a table laid for a feast, and you knew what was on it.
You dreamt they were all watching you eat.
You dreamt you were the meat.
nightmare: You woke screaming. You don't remember why; your hands do.
You dreamt they came back wrong, and you let them in.
You woke sure someone was standing over you. Nobody was. Probably.

journal._about: The journal's voice (JournalVoice, call 119): a templated journal line ({line}, kept word for word) in the writer's voice by trait (optimist, gloomy, hot_headed, pious, calm), per event (death, bite, dark, break, arrival, letter) or any. Written, not spoken: no voice keys.

death.optimist: {line} We keep going; it's what they'd want.
death.gloomy: {line} Another name for the list. The list only gets longer.
death.hot_headed: {line} Somebody is going to pay for this.
death.pious: {line} Lord, keep them. Keep the rest of us too.
death.calm: {line} We buried what we could and went on.

bite.gloomy: {line} We all know how this ends.
bite.hot_headed: {line} I put the thing down myself, twice over.
bite.calm: {line} Cleaned it, dressed it, wrote down the hour.

dark.optimist: {line} We lived. That has to count for something.
dark.gloomy: {line} There's no coming back from this, and we know it.
dark.hot_headed: {line} Don't judge me. You weren't there, you weren't starving.
dark.pious: {line} Forgive us. I don't think anyone will.
dark.calm: {line} It was that or nothing. I won't write about it again.

break.optimist: {line} They'll come round. We all do.
break.gloomy: {line} It's only a matter of time for the rest of us.
break.pious: {line} I sat with them and prayed.
break.calm: {line} I gave them space and water.

arrival.gloomy: {line} Another mouth. Let's see how long.

letter.hot_headed: {line} Said what I should have said years ago.
